nav.agent.live: LLM_MODE=live: OpenRouter, with the key from the environment
nav.agent.mock: LLM_MODE=mock: a recorded scenario, no API key anywhere
screen.dashboard.hint: the instance, what needs a person, and the governance in force
screen.system.hint: processes, devices, databases and the host under them
screen.security.hint: users, roles, resources and what they add up to
screen.secrets.hint: wallet, TLS and OAuth2, read only
screen.webapps.hint: applications, REST services and their specifications
screen.tasks.hint: the scheduler, its history and its suspended tasks
screen.logs.hint: messages.log, alerts.log and the system audit in one feed
screen.interop.hint: productions, the messages through them and what failed
screen.packages.hint: what IPM installed here, and what the registry publishes
screen.tools.hint: every operation the portal can perform
screen.policy.hint: the rules every call is decided by, and a place to try them
screen.audit.hint: what the portal did, in order - beside the agent that did some of it
screen.agent.hint: ask in words; same tools, same policy, same journal
screen.findings.hint: what is wrong with this instance, and the operation that fixes it
screen.version.hint: what this build serves, and the operations it does not have
badge.tasks: suspended tasks - read from %SYS.Task, not from the API
badge.logs: severe or fatal entries in the last hour
badge.interop: productions with errored messages in the last hour
badge.findings: open issues - read-only checks that failed
ribbon.scope.usable: Narrows the rows this screen lists. It does not change the namespace your session runs in; the portal never does that.
ribbon.search: Run an operation, jump to a screen, search the journal…
status.api.waiting: Asking the instance for the first time.
status.api.limited: /api/admin is up, but this build does not serve everything the portal asks for. See the Version screen.
status.api.down: The last poll of /api/admin did not come back.
palette.empty: Nothing in the registry or the screens matches.
palette.footerRight: the decision shown is what the policy would answer for you, now
findings.metaTitle: Read-only checks over what the portal can already see. Nothing here writes; the repairs do, and they go through the policy.
findings.cleanHint: Every check ran and found nothing.
findings.fixTitle: Runs the operation through the policy, the confirmation and the journal.
findings.denied: The policy refuses this repair by rule {rule}.
findings.noFixLong: No operation in the registry repairs this one, so act on it by hand.
audit.turnTitle: One agent turn. Click to drop the filter.
audit.exportChainTitle: The whole journal with its digests, in the form they were computed over, for checking somewhere else.
audit.chain.explain: Each row carries the digest of the one before it, over the actor, the tool, the canonical arguments, the decision and the outcome.
audit.chain.offlineTitle: A static page that re-computes these digests offline. Export the chain, drop the file on it; it never talks to this instance.
audit.journal.metaTitle: Server-side filtering: the journal only grows, and the refusal worth finding is rarely on the last page.
audit.emptyHint: The journal fills as soon as a tool is invoked, including the ones the policy refuses.
audit.agentMark: The agent. Its calls go through the same policy and land in this same journal - there is no separate agent log.
audit.userMark: A person: from a screen here, or from a script with their account.
policy.rules.metaTitle: Editing is the policy.update tool: validated, confirmed by a human and written to the journal like every other write.
policy.noRulesHint: Every call falls through to the default.
policy.versionTitle: {at} by {by}. Opens it in the editor; saving it makes it the current version.
policy.privileges.metaTitle: Taken from the operation summaries in the pinned specification: true as a minimum, not always sufficient. The verdict is still the live 403.
sim.metaTitle: The one call in the portal with no consequences: the same engine decides, no confirmation is issued and no journal row is written.
sim.actorTitle: Who is asking. A rule can match on it: agent:* is how the agent's writes are made to stop for a human.
sim.args: Arguments: the rules match on them.
sim.idle: Pick an operation and fill in as much as a rule would look at. Nothing here executes anything.
sim.says.allow: This would run, and the journal would record it.
sim.says.confirm: The server would answer 409 with a confirmation token, and nothing would run until somebody clicked.
sim.says.deny: This would be refused before reaching the instance, and the refusal would be journalled too.
agent.removeTitle: Delete this conversation; the journal keeps its calls
screen.reach.hint: who reaches the sensitive resources of this instance, and by which path
reach.metaTitle: Anonymous is always shown. Accounts are shown for the traced resources only, and accounts with the same set of paths are one row.
reach.reloadTitle: Read users, roles and web applications from the instance again now
reach.info.what: Who can get to the most sensitive parts of this instance - superuser rights, the system database, secure administration - and how: through a web application, a role, or both. Paths from Anonymous need no password at all.
reach.info.fix: Click a path to see how to close it. Preview fix redraws the map as it would be, without changing anything.
reach.info.when: The map is read when you open this screen and after a fix is applied. Press ↻ after changing users, roles or web applications elsewhere.
reach.previewTitle: Redraws the map as it would look after this operation, and asks the policy what it would decide. Neither runs anything.
reach.pinnedTitle: Its paths stay lit until you release it. Click the node again, or the background.
activity.noFailures: nothing failed in the last day
attention.clean: Every check ran and found nothing.
storage.dbTitle: {name}: {size}, {free} of it free inside the file
storage.journal: Journal written per day, MB · {free} free where it is written
scheduler.nothing: Nothing is scheduled in the next 24 hours.
changes.empty: Nothing changed and nothing was refused yet. Anything that writes, or that the policy stops, lands here.
activity.p95Title: 95% of calls took less than this; half took less than {p50} ms
dash.state: System state: {state} (iris_system_state = {n}). IRIS's own summary of its health from /api/monitor/metrics: 0 OK, 1 warning, 2 alert, -1 hung.
activity.chain.okTitle: The journal's hash chain is intact: {n} entries, each hashed over the one before. Walked end to end just now; the Audit screen has the export to check it elsewhere.
attention.fixTitle:
{call}
The policy will answer: {decision} (rule {rule}). Runs through the same confirmation and journal as the Diagnostics screen.
